title: Wayland
summary: Wayland is a local-first desktop AI command center that drives multiple AI CLI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, etc.) from one app, with a large built-in skills library of task templates the agent can invoke. One of these skills, a synthetic-data-generator, packages SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer (via sdv.metadata.Metadata and sdv.single_table) as an on-demand capability for generating synthetic tabular data.
evidence: src/.../synthetic-data-generator/SKILL.md:62-77 shows GaussianCopulaSynthesizer(metadata) and CTGANSynthesizer(metadata, epochs=300,...) fit on real_data
needs: Unclear whether this skill file is actually executed by the agent at runtime or only present as a template/example in the skills-library bundle.
